## Summary

Static read-only trace of `amz-listing-kit-issue9-expression` (= current `main` + PR18 slice `3dc0018`; PR18 closeout: 8 commits/186 files, not merged) against design §13.3/13.5/13.6/13.7/13.8/13.10 and plan §17.3/§17.4-B3. No runtime, tests, or LSP (none configured; text-based caller tracing per parent IRC).

**Conclusions**
1. **Two-mode rework does not exist.** `ReworkDirective` is still `v2.5.4` with no `mode` (`domain/rework.js:13`); `ReworkIntent` has no `mode` (`generation.ts:286-297`); the rework panel has no mode control; and the candidate's Blob is **never** put into the outbound reference array. Today's single rework path compiles a text directive + sends **product intake references only** — request-level that is exactly the desired `regenerate_original`, but it is unlabeled, its prompt paragraph hardcodes "只改这张图，其它段落保持不变…不要重复出现上一条候选…" (`domain/prompt.js:1064-1073`), and there is no edit path. So both modes need real work; regenerate is not a rename.
2. **The OCC/reservation chain is a single linearized path that recomputes references in four places**, all comparing against `prompt.request_snapshot.references`: `generation.ts:1174-1180` (currentness), `generation.ts:1275-1283` (submit), `storage/repository.js:503-507` (`checkGenerationSources`, in-transaction), plus `repository.js:552-554` (reserved attempt vs frozen prompt). Any candidate-first reference must be reproduced identically at every site, and `promptStaleness` must not go stale when *new* candidates arrive (`domain/prompt.js:1910+`; basis already carries a `rework` block with `directive_id/candidate_id/candidate_sha256`, but no mode).
3. **Adapters need no change**: both iterate `request.references` in order and append prompt last (DashScope `src/providers/v2_dashscope_image.py:330-334`; Ark `v2_volcengine_image.py:319-323`); gateway validates count/media (`v2_image.py:103-107`). Do not add mask/seed/editor API.
4. **Human surface**: the compare view already has a stable fine-view with viewed candidate, candidate-only "对照候选" left slot, per-`project::shot::candidateId` drafts (already on main), and adoption/viewed separation. Missing: left default = product evidence with switch-back, distinct problem-candidate/model-source display, mode inside the draft, multi-draft chooser. Six-stage nav is hard-wired in `stage-shell.js` + `index.html` + `workspace.js` projections; four-stage regrouping and the batch-send checkboxes are #8 work, not present.
5. `.p5-ref/` at the workspace root is an **older** snapshot (drafts keyed by shot only); it contains no two-mode/four-stage reference — do not mine it.

## Architecture

`views (input/generation/compare/delivery) → owner modules (inputs/prompts/generation/adoption/review-delivery) → storage repository (IndexedDB)`; views hold only in-place state and DOM, never transactions. Rework submit path today: compare-view `previewRework` → `generation.prepareRework` (compiles via prompts, zero writes) → view keeps the immutable intent → `confirmRework` → `prompts.compileAndSave({rework})` → `promptsSheet([shot])` → `confirmAndRun(intentForScope([shot],"rework"))` → `reserveGenerationAttempt` (single linearization point; fence + `checkGenerationSources` + mode gate) → POST `/api/v2/images/submit` with `buildReferencePayload` bytes → attempt observation / candidate store. Confirm doc id for rework is `rework:<shotId>`; reservation mode …

## Report

### 1. Existing vs missing (two-mode generation + human-surface seams)

| Seam | Exists today (branch = main+PR18) | Missing for final contract |
|---|---|---|
| Mode on directive | `ReworkDirective v2.5.4` {directive_id, shot_id, candidate_id, candidate_sha256, problems, direction, source, created_at} | `mode: edit_candidate|regenerate_original`; contract v2.5.5; builder/checker/summary/isCurrent in sync (design §13.6/§13.8) |
| Candidate bytes in request | Never; `selectReferences` only re-orders intake refs (role-quota, dedup by sha, limit 3) | edit mode: candidate ORIGINAL blob first, then product evidence in existing binding order; regenerate: product evidence only, never silently interchanged |
| Reference metadata | `(role, sha256)` everywhere; snapshot `references` role+sha (`prompt.js:1391-1404`) | non-secret `uses[]` + `sources[]` on `PromptReferenceSelection`/frozen snapshot; merge same bytes (keep dual uses); do NOT enter gateway body |
| Prompt text vs image numbering | Rework paragraph asserts "其它段落保持不变" and tells the model not to repeat candidate issues; `product_fidelity` says product refs are the sole authority | edit: numbered image roles (candidate = 待修问题, product = fact authority, candidate artifacts correctable), problem position/phenomenon, keep/allow; regenerate: full-goal re-expression, no candidate reference, no "keep image 1" wording (§13.6, §13.14.5) |
| Currentness | `reworkStaleReason` covers session/candidate identity+sha+version/directive/prompt hash/fence JSON/provider; new candidates do not stale it (candidate chain absent from basis) | add mode into the frozen/basis values; keep "only new candidate arrives ≠ stale"; candidate bytes unresolvable ⇒ blocked at payload build (already `buildReferencePayload` throws) |
| OCC reserve | 4 recompute/compare sites + `authorization_mismatch`; fence appends reference shas (generation.ts:1342-1348) | make all recompute sites rework-aware (or pass selected refs) so edit-mode arrays match; decide Attempt 2→3 (design §13.8) vs keep transport `{role,sha256}` projection |
| Confirm summary | per-shot `referencesLine` + `reference_count/reference_roles` from snapshot refs; single "确认并生成" | summary must show mode + actual model source (candidate vs product-refs), the one confirmation stays |
| Viewed / adopted / left / problem / model-source | viewed (right), adopted badges, left = candidate-only 对照, problem candidate = `rework.entry` gate | default left = product evidence (with explicit switch to any historical candidate and back), distinct model-source label; viewed object unchanged when left/history changes |
| Draft | keyed `project::shot::candidateId` (already on main), problems/direction/intent survive collapse; `dirtyReworkDraft` invalidates preview on edit | mode per draft; multi-non-empty-draft chooser; never `find`-pick silently (§13.3) |
| Late results | owner notify → views re-render; drafts in memory; submit path re-focuses source candidate | explicit "late arrival must not swap source/steal focus" observables; candidate arriving during preview must not alter frozen source |
| Navigation | six stages everywhere (definitions, nav, panels, projections, foot buttons, cross-view `selectStage` targets) | four grouped entries (资料与事实 / 方案 / 制作与审图 / 交付) with one underlying state; no dual nav (§13.3, #8) |
| Batch send scope | scope = `authorizationScope` (set by failed-retry/explicit-new) or batch queue; no user checkboxes | #8 B3: batch-mode checkboxes that never change view/adopt/source; summary re-validation on change |

### 2. Contracts expression/domain owner must agree on

1. `PromptReferenceSelection` → `{role, sha256, uses: ("edit_source"|"product_truth"|"style_reference")[] (non-empty, dedup), sources: {kind:"candidate"|"product_input", document_id, version>0, asset_sha256}[] }`; array order = model order; project bound by intent. Same-bytes merge keeps both uses. (`type-contracts.d.ts:546`).
2. `ReworkDirective` v2 (contract `v2.5.5`): `+mode`; keep `candidate_id/candidate_sha256` as the fixed problem candidate; `reworkIsCurrent/checkReworkDirective/buildReworkDirective/reworkSummaryText` updated together. `PromptReferenceSelection` selection for edit mode derived **from the directive**, not from live chain order.
3. `selectReferences(shot, refs, {maxReferences})` → must accept the rework context (mode + candidate ref) or be replaced by a single selection function used by all four recompute sites: `prompts.compile` (176), `generation.ts:1177`, `generation.ts:1275`, `repository.checkGenerationSources:503`. Limit: edit source occupies one slot of `provider.max_reference_images`; product refs that no longer fit ⇒ block with user-trim action, never silent drop.
4. Snapshot/basis: `requestSnapshotOf`/`checkSnapshotAgainstProfile`/`buildPromptRecord`/`promptHash` carry the extended refs (Prompt schema 1→2, new hashes computed, no fake records); `basis.rework` gains `mode` (and enough identity to recompute); `promptStaleness` must not treat new candidates as staleness, may treat a *changed/removed* consumed candidate as stale.
5. Attempt: either keep schema 2 with `references` projected to `{role, sha256}` (role `other` for the candidate) while the metadata lives in the prompt snapshot — then `reserveGenerationAttempt`'s pending-vs-snapshot compare must compare like-for-like; or bump Attempt 2→3 per design §13.8. Whichever, `checkAttemptRecord` (1..3, REFERENCE_ROLES) must accept `other`.
6. `ConfirmationSubmissionMode`: keep `"rework"` for both modes (reservation gate semantics identical, `repository.js:578-585`) and put the image mode in the directive/prompt; if new modes are added instead, all four places change in one package (`confirm.js:35`, `type-contracts.d.ts:606`, `repository.js:578-585`, `confirm.js:632-636`).
7. Gateway stays `{role, media_type, sha256, data_base64}`; `uses/sources/mode` never added to the POST body (§13.6 rule 3); `createGenerationModule` validation unchanged.
8. Same-package consumer switches: `confirm.js` shot rows/statement (mode/source display), `generation-view.ts` confirm region, compare-view references list stays product-only, `selection-adoption.ts:392-420` review payload unchanged in meaning, `review-delivery.ts` consumes candidate + attempt-frozen prompt (only if attempt shape changes).

### 3. Smallest complete two-mode user-path closure

Kept to existing owners (no new module/dispatch):
1. **Domain** (`rework.js`, `prompt.js`, `type-contracts.d.ts`, `attempt.ts`): mode + evidence-based references + image-role sentence + mode-specific rework section + snapshot metadata + schema bumps as decided above.
2. **Generation** (`generation.ts`): `PrepareReworkInput/ReworkIntent` gain mode + ordered reference preview; `confirmRework` unchanged in structure (compileAndSave → sheet → `intentForScope([shot],"rework")` → confirmAndRun); stale reasons unchanged in kind.
3. **Storage** (`repository.js`): rework-aware recompute inside `checkGenerationSources` from `prompt.basis.rework`; keep fence/asset checks.
4. **UI** (`compare-view.ts`): mode selector bound to the draft (default `edit_candidate`), preview meta shows mode + actual image count/order, model-source line; draft key unchanged; submit path/focus unchanged. Left-default product evidence + multi-draft chooser are #8/B4 surface items and must not be smuggled in as request-truth work.
5. **Not in scope**: mask/seed/editor API, new owner platform, CSS overflow suppression, any claim about the unresolved 5712px case.

**Observables for later runtime smoke** (Transport-level, memory decode, no paid calls): edit run decodes `[candidate_sha, ...product_shas in binding order]`; regenerate run decodes product shas only and equals today's reference array; frozen `request_snapshot.references` carries uses/sources and `basis.rework.mode` equals the chosen mode; preview→mode switch→confirm returns stale (zero POST); absent candidate bytes ⇒ single `reference_read_failed` skip, zero POST, prompt untouched; new candidate arriving during preview ⇒ no source swap, draft text+mode restored on return (key `project::shot::candidateId`), cancel returns focus to the rework entry; adopt/summary/两包 still consume the original action's frozen prompt.

### 2. Contracts expression/domain owner must agree on

1. `PromptReferenceSelection` → `{role, sha256, uses: ("edit_source"|"product_truth"|"style_reference")[] (non-empty, dedup), sources: {kind:"candidate"|"product_input", document_id, version>0, asset_sha256}[] }`; array order = model order; project bound by intent. Same-bytes merge keeps both uses. (`type-contracts.d.ts:546`).
2. `ReworkDirective` v2 (contract `v2.5.5`): `+mode`; keep `candidate_id/candidate_sha256` as the fixed problem candidate; `reworkIsCurrent/checkReworkDirective/buildReworkDirective/reworkSummaryText` updated together. `PromptReferenceSelection` selection for edit mode derived **from the directive**, not from live chain order.
3. `selectReferences(shot, refs, {maxReferences})` → must accept the rework context (mode + candidate ref) or be replaced by a single selection function used by all four recompute sites: `prompts.compile` (176), `generation.ts:1177`, `generation.ts:1275`, `repository.checkGenerationSources:503`. Limit: edit source occupies one slot of `provider.max_reference_images`; product refs that no longer fit ⇒ block with user-trim action, never silent drop.
4. Snapshot/basis: `requestSnapshotOf`/`checkSnapshotAgainstProfile`/`buildPromptRecord`/`promptHash` carry the extended refs (Prompt schema 1→2, new hashes computed, no fake records); `basis.rework` gains `mode` (and enough identity to recompute); `promptStaleness` must not treat new candidates as staleness, may treat a *changed/removed* consumed candidate as stale.
5. Attempt: either keep schema 2 with `references` projected to `{role, sha256}` (role `other` for the candidate) while the metadata lives in the prompt snapshot — then `reserveGenerationAttempt`'s pending-vs-snapshot compare must compare like-for-like; or bump Attempt 2→3 per design §13.8. Whichever, `checkAttemptRecord` (1..3, REFERENCE_ROLES) must accept `other`.
6. `ConfirmationSubmissionMode`: keep `"rework"` for both modes (reservation gate semantics identical, `repository.js:578-585`) and put the image mode in the directive/prompt; if new modes are added instead, all four places change in one package (`confirm.js:35`, `type-contracts.d.ts:606`, `repository.js:578-585`, `confirm.js:632-636`).
7. Gateway stays `{role, media_type, sha256, data_base64}`; `uses/sources/mode` never added to the POST body (§13.6 rule 3); `createGenerationModule` validation unchanged.
8. Same-package consumer switches: `confirm.js` shot rows/statement (mode/source display), `generation-view.ts` confirm region, compare-view references list stays product-only, `selection-adoption.ts:392-420` review payload unchanged in meaning, `review-delivery.ts` consumes candidate + attempt-frozen prompt (only if attempt shape changes).

### 3. Smallest complete two-mode user-path closure

Kept to existing owners (no new module/dispatch):
1. **Domain** (`rework.js`, `prompt.js`, `type-contracts.d.ts`, `attempt.ts`): mode + evidence-based references + image-role sentence + mode-specific rework section + snapshot metadata + schema bumps as decided above.
2. **Generation** (`generation.ts`): `PrepareReworkInput/ReworkIntent` gain mode + ordered reference preview; `confirmRework` unchanged in structure (compileAndSave → sheet → `intentForScope([shot],"rework")` → confirmAndRun); stale reasons unchanged in kind.
3. **Storage** (`repository.js`): rework-aware recompute inside `checkGenerationSources` from `prompt.basis.rework`; keep fence/asset checks.
4. **UI** (`compare-view.ts`): mode selector bound to the draft (default `edit_candidate`), preview meta shows mode + actual image count/order, model-source line; draft key unchanged; submit path/focus unchanged. Left-default product evidence + multi-draft chooser are #8/B4 surface items and must not be smuggled in as request-truth work.
5. **Not in scope**: mask/seed/editor API, new owner platform, CSS overflow suppression, any claim about the unresolved 5712px case.

**Observables for later runtime smoke** (Transport-level, memory decode, no paid calls): edit run decodes `[candidate_sha, ...product_shas in binding order]`; regenerate run decodes product shas only and equals today's reference array; frozen `request_snapshot.references` carries uses/sources and `basis.rework.mode` equals the chosen mode; preview→mode switch→confirm returns stale (zero POST); absent candidate bytes ⇒ single `reference_read_failed` skip, zero POST, prompt untouched; new candidate arriving during preview ⇒ no source swap, draft text+mode restored on return (key `project::shot::candidateId`), cancel returns focus to the rework entry; adopt/summary/两包 still consume the original action's frozen prompt.
